p: when he had called unto him: The apostles are sent to preach the gospel in Israel.
first: Theophylact says that Peter and Andrew are called the first, because they were first called.
Iscariot: A man of Kerioth. Now Kerioth was in the tribe of Judah; Jos 15:25.
And as ye go: The sum of the gospel, or preaching of the apostles.
Heal the sick: Miracles are signs verifying the word.
Provide: The ministers of the word must cast away all cares that might hinder them, even the least of them.

neither gold: For this journey, namely, both that nothing might hinder them, and also that they might feel some taste of God's providence: for at their return back, the Lord asked of them whether they lacked anything by the way, Lu 22:35.
meat: God will provide you with food.
And into whatsoever city or town: Happy are they that receive the preaching of the gospel: and unhappy are they that refuse it.
peace come upon it: It is an idiom taken from the Hebrews, by which they meant every type of happiness.
Behold: Christ shows how the ministers must behave themselves under the cross.
sheep in the midst of wolves: You will be in great danger.

harmless as doves: You will not so much as take revenge for an injury: and by the mixing of these beast's natures together, he will not have our wisdom to be malicious, nor our simplicity mad, but a certain form of good nature which is composed exquisitely of both of them.
men: For in the cause of religion men are wolves to each other.
gone over the cities of Israel: Bring to an end, that is, you will not have gone through all the cities of Israel and preached in them.
Beelzebub: It was the idol of the Acronites, which we call the god of flies.
Fear them not therefore: Truth will not always be hidden.
housetops: Openly, and in the highest places. For the tops of their houses were made in such a way that they might walk upon them; Ac 10:9.
fear not them which kill the: Though tyrants rage and are cruel, yet we must not fear them.
farthing: The fourth part of an ounce or seven grams.
Whosoever therefore shall confess me before: The necessity and reward of openly confessing Christ.
Think not that I am come: Civil dissentions follow the preaching of the gospel.
He that loveth father or mother: Without exception, nothing is to be preferred before our duty to God.

findeth his life shall lose it: They are said to find their life, who deliver it out of danger: and this is spoken against the opinion of the people, who think those that die are certainly lost, because they think not of the life to come.
He that receiveth you receiveth me: God is both author and revenger of his holy ministry.
He that receiveth a prophet in: We will lose nothing that is bestowed on Christ.
the name of a prophet shall: As a Prophet.
little ones a cup of cold: Who in the sight of the world are vile and abject.
